name: CARDIACS Sports & Memorabilia
tagline: Trading cards and fan gear: Pokémon and sports cards (NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, soccer, racing), card supplies, memorabilia, wall art, lanyards, mini mascots, ornaments and tailgating gear
about: North Carolina's sports-card and memorabilia shop since 2007, with stores in Kannapolis (133 West Ave) and Apex. Sell your cards to CARDIACS, book an appointment, or ask about grading. CARDIACS Cares gives back to the community, and this season both stores collect new, unwrapped toys for Toys for Tots (donation boxes by the front entrance).

ktown.title: Sam Mayer & Dale Earnhardt's #41 K-2 Tribute Car | Jonny Cannon & CARDIACS Sports & Memorabilia
ktown.summary: Jonny Cannon of CARDIACS Sports & Memorabilia is helping bring a piece of Kannapolis racing history back to Charlotte Motor Speedway. In this special trackside episode of K-Town Connection, Sam Mayer’s No. 41 Haas Factory Team Chevrolet wears pink in tribute to K-2, the car Dale Earnhardt drove early in his NASCAR career, with the Dayvault Tune-Up & Brake Service name on its side.
